note: Counter rules, all additive and all explained. tagCounters give complete coverage for every hero in the registry, classCounters add archetype pressure, and heroCounters are named overrides for matchups worth stating explicitly. Every row's `reason` is the *mechanism* — what the interaction does, with no claim about whose hero is whose. The side is supplied at render time by src/engine/reason.js, because the same rule is read from opposite perspectives (a pick reason looks outward from our hero, a threat note inward from theirs). Writing the rule and writing the mechanism is still the same act — writing the rule and writing the explanation are the same act, so an explanation can never drift from the logic.
